meta.title: Your page | {{brand.name}} for hosts
meta.description: A free organiser page that replaces the link in your bio: your next event, your links, everything coming up, reviews with your replies, and followers. Claim it with Instagram or Luma.
meta.socialDescription: A page that replaces the link in your bio. Make yours, or claim it if it’s already on {{brand.name}}.

sections.title: A page that replaces the link in your bio.
sections.lead: Your next event, your links, everything coming up (including events you run elsewhere), reviews with your replies, and people who follow you for the next one.
sections.note: Free to set up · Made and edited in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}

sections.title: Everything someone from Instagram is looking for.

items.title: Next up
items.body: Your next event straight under your name, with a Book button.

items.title: Your links
items.body: WhatsApp community, Strava, merch, perks: the links your bio used to hold.

items.title: Everything coming up
items.body: Events on {{brand.name}}, and events you run on other sites as tiles that link out.

items.title: Reviews, with replies
items.body: Reviews from people who booked are marked “Booked on {{brand.name}}”. Reply in public to show you care.

items.title: Followers
items.body: People follow you with their phone number, and you can send them an update about your next event.

items.title: About and team
items.body: Who runs it, when and where, and who it suits, with a verified mark once you’ve claimed it.

sections.title: Let people who came do the selling.
sections.lead: Reviews from booked guests carry a badge, and the rating counts only those. Your replies sit under them.

rows.title: A review from a guest who booked

sections.title: Your page may already be here.
sections.lead: {{brand.name}} builds organiser pages from public sources so guests can find them. If yours is listed, claim it and it’s yours to edit.

items.title: Find your page and tap Claim.
Sign in with your phone number.
Prove it’s yours with a code on your Instagram or your Luma calendar.
Finish in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}: add events and links. Events go live when you publish them.

sections.title: See what your page is doing.
sections.lead: Signed in as the owner, your page shows the last 30 days: visits, new followers, link clicks and taps on Book.
sections.body: Every page carries “Made with {{brand.name}}”, so the next organiser can make one too.

items.question: How much does a page cost?
items.answer: Nothing. Pages are free; {{brand.name}} only takes a fee on paid tickets sold through it.

items.question: Why is my club already listed?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} builds organiser pages from public sources so guests can find them. Claim the page and it’s yours to edit, or tell us if something is wrong.

items.question: How do I prove the page is mine?
items.answer: Sign in with your phone number, then add a code we give you to your Instagram or your Luma calendar. When we find it, the page is yours.

items.question: When do my events appear?
items.answer: When you publish them. Nothing you set up in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} goes live until you do.

items.question: Can I show events I run on other sites?
items.answer: Yes. They appear on your page as tiles that link out to where people book them.

items.question: Can I reply to reviews?
items.answer: Yes, once the page is yours. Your reply shows under the review.

items.question: Where do I edit my page?
items.answer: In the {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} app, on iPhone, Android or iPad.

sections.title: Make your page tonight.
sections.lead: Download {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}, set up your page and first event, and put the link in your bio.
